baseline.authority: docs/design/UI2_0_C3_IDENTITY_SESSIONS_RBAC_CONTRACT.md (FROZEN, PRODUCT OWNER APPROVED, 2026-09-09), section 3.3: a session ends role:security_admin-revoked, idle_timeout, absolute_lifetime, login_elsewhere, or access_group_lost, and the C3-gated SESSION_REVOKE action already exists exactly on that authority. AuditPresentationAllowlist already names the sessions columns safe to render in full: session_id, actor_fingerprint, created_at, last_seen_at, idle_deadline_at, absolute_expires_at, state, end_reason, ended_by_actor_fingerprint, superseded_by_session_id.
baseline.engineering: NXS-LOCAL-0361 (in flight, separate movement) corrects IDLE_TIMEOUT to the contract's stated 30 minutes; this movement does not depend on that value and must not duplicate or re-litigate it. Session identity display: reuse whatever the existing Administration screen already uses to turn an actor_fingerprint into a human-readable label for the Local identities tab -- do not invent a second resolution path.
baseline.observed: SessionAdminController already exposes POST /sessions/revoke, gated to role:security_admin, and SessionRepository already models exactly the fields a session list needs. But there is no list endpoint (SessionRepository has no findAll/listActive method) and no frontend screen at all: the product can end a session but cannot show one. The Product Owner asked for a Session management screen: current session count, concurrent sessions, and the ability to see and act on them -- the backend capability to act (revoke) already exists; only visibility is missing.

recommended_reasoning.reason: A bounded read-and-display screen over an existing, already-gated backend capability; no new security decision, no schema change.

requirements: The session list endpoint returns only the columns already named safe in AuditPresentationAllowlist for 'sessions' -- no column outside that set
The endpoint is gated exactly as /sessions/revoke is: role:security_admin, the same E1-E4 chain, no separate authorization path invented
A session already past its deadline is never listed as active -- the same expire-before-read discipline the existing repository methods already use
The identity shown for a session reuses the existing actor_fingerprint-to-label resolution already used elsewhere on the Administration screen; it does not invent a new one
The revoke action in the new screen calls the existing POST /sessions/revoke unchanged
The idle timeout and absolute lifetime values shown are read-only display, not an editable control
risks: Do not add a hidden findAll that bypasses expirePastDeadline's semantics -- reuse that discipline exactly, or the list will show sessions the rest of the product already treats as gone.
This is a Gradle checkout: use ./gradlew, not mvn.

The frontend test runner needs node_modules, which a fresh worktree does not carry. If npm test or tsc cannot start, link or install ui2/frontend dependencies in the worktree and run them; do not report BLOCKED with the work unvalidated.

Do not touch NXS-LOCAL-0361's IDLE_TIMEOUT change if it has already landed on main by the time this movement starts -- read whatever value is current and display it; do not hardcode 5 or 30 minutes into this movement's own code or tests.

in: SessionRepository: an additional read method listing active sessions (as-of now, expiring past-deadline ones first exactly as the existing findBySessionId/findActiveByActor defaults already do, so the list never shows a session that is actually already expired)
A new GET /sessions endpoint, gated to role:security_admin exactly like /sessions/revoke, returning only the columns AuditPresentationAllowlist already names safe for 'sessions' in full

A new 'Sessions' tab or section on the Administration screen: a table of active sessions (identity label, created_at, last_seen_at, idle_deadline_at, absolute_expires_at) with a Revoke action per row wired to the existing POST /sessions/revoke
A header metric: total active session count, and each identity's own active session count next to its row
A read-only display of the two current session-duration values (idle timeout, absolute lifetime) as currently configured -- no control to change them
Tests for the list endpoint's gating, its field set, and the frontend table plus revoke wiring
out: Making idle timeout or absolute lifetime editable from the UI or from any endpoint -- that turns a fixed value into a runtime-mutable security parameter and needs its own decision before it is built, not implied by this ask
Any change to login, session creation, supersede-on-login-elsewhere, or the E1-E6 gate chain
NXS-LOCAL-0361's IDLE_TIMEOUT correction, which is a separate, already-dispatched movement
Revoking a session other than through the existing endpoint, or any new revoke semantics
